summary.intent: Triage and fix defects found by two bug-hunt agents in the Callisto release tool, opening separate PRs per fix, then continue with the remaining npm and changelog defects.
summary.outcome: Opened PRs #541 (init artifact-target E197), #542 (Python `==1.*` pin), and #543 (restore written files after E208 lockfile refresh failure). Reproduced the npm `v`/`~>` spec bug and fixed it by normalising at parse time, with a unit test and changeset on branch fix/npm-v-prefixed-specs; checks were still running at the end of the transcript.

repo: Each fix goes on its own branch off origin/main with a signed commit, a changeset file in .changeset/, and a PR linked via `entire trail link`.
Checks are run through a helper script (check2.sh) pointed at the worktree, and fmt/tests run via cargo (`cargo fmt --all`, `cargo test -q -p <crate>`).

Error E208 (lockfile refresh failure) docs imply a retry should work; the old help text advising to run the command manually was wrong once files are restored, so the help and docs row had to be updated along with the code.

Spec VER-AGG-04 starts the commit-inference window at the last tag, which causes `version` to re-bump with release-trigger=auto until the release is tagged. This is a design question, not a regression.
Poetry caret/tilde dependents deliberately do not take pre-release/snapshot versions per the spec, so E319 there is a product gap, not a bug.

code.finding: parse_npm_spec_str did not recognise `v`-prefixed (`v1.2.3`, `=v1.2.3`, `^v1.2.3`) or `~>` specs, so such dependents were never tested or rewritten. Because the write path does not compare the old text, normalising at parse time is safe (`v` dropped, `~>` becomes `~`).
Unit tests for npm spec parsing live here; a `v_prefixed` test was added.
Changelog writing logic that prepends a new `# <package>` heading; this is where the duplicate-H1 bug with an existing `# Changelog` title originates. Inspected but not yet changed.

workflow: Reproduce agent-reported findings with a small shell script before fixing them; this confirmed the npm `v`/`~>` bug with a `^1.2.3` control.
Stash-free isolation: create a fresh branch from origin/main with `git checkout --no-track -b` so each PR contains only its own change.
Clearly separating verified, agent-reported, skipped and needs-decision findings in summaries keeps the user oriented.

friction: Fixes were developed in a shared worktree (verify-manifest-findings) containing multiple changes, so each had to be moved onto its own branch from origin/main.
The user had to ask what the findings were and what was being addressed, because the earlier summary was not detailed enough.
Two of the agent-reported findings (npm `v` prefix, changelog heading) and the inference re-bump were not reproduced by the assistant before reporting; the `v` prefix was reproduced only later.
open_items: npm overrides: an exact override `1.2.3` becomes `~2.0.0`, and `pnpm.overrides` is never updated. Reproduced, not fixed.
Changelog heading: an existing `# Changelog` or `# Changelog for a` title leads to two H1s. Needs reproduction and a fix.
Finish the checks for fix/npm-v-prefixed-specs, then commit and open a PR.
User decision needed: should `version` treat an already-versioned inferred bump as consumed under release-trigger=auto?
Product decision needed: Poetry caret/tilde dependents cannot take snapshot or pre-release versions.
Skipped config edge cases: `changelog` pointing at Cargo.toml or a source file, and `[changesets] dir`/`changelog` accepting `..` or `.git`.
